description: Mixed-media collage depicting a loose, gestural humanoid figure assembled from ink drawing, painted paper fragments, and compact discs. Speech bubble with handwritten text "I'm gonna doing it" emerges from the figure's head; collaged elements include green and brown shapes at the torso and blue water imagery at the base.
keywords: handwritten text ink drawing mixed media
gestural figure with water imagery base
title: I'm Gonna Do It
